5	// Flat, ordered list of every file in the tree (a group's own files, then
6	// its subgroups' files, recursively). Shared by the upload worker (order to
7	// process files in), the upload modal's per-group rollup counts, and the
8	// "every file in this group is done" check driving the Open-in-Drive link —
9	// one traversal so they can't drift out of sync on how they handle nesting.

14	export interface FileTreeHandle {
15	  root: string | null
16	  tree: LocalFileGroup | null
17	  loading: boolean
18	  error: string | null

20	  // cancelled the dialog), so callers know when a fresh root replaced the
21	  // previous one and any per-root state (e.g. the upload queue) should reset.

23	}

25	export function useFileTree(): FileTreeHandle {

27	  const [tree, setTree] = useState<LocalFileGroup | null>(null)

1	import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
2	import { LocalFileGroup, DriveAssignment } from '../types'
3	
4	export interface DriveAssignmentsHandle {
5	  groupAssignments: Map<string, DriveAssignment>
6	  fileOverrides: Map<string, DriveAssignment>
7	  setGroupAssignment: (groupKey: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => void
8	  clearGroupAssignment: (groupKey: string) => void
9	  setFileOverride: (filePath: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => void
10	  clearFileOverride: (filePath: string) => void
11	}
12	
13	// Tracks Drive folder assignments made directly on a subfolder group or on
14	// an individual file (a file-level assignment overrides its group's).
15	// Resolving the *effective* assignment for a given group/file (own, else
16	// inherited from the nearest ancestor group, else none) is the caller's
17	// job, since only the caller knows the tree structure to walk.
18	export function useDriveAssignments(): DriveAssignmentsHandle {
19	  const [groupAssignments, setGroupAssignments] = useState<Map<string, DriveAssignment>>(new Map())
20	  const [fileOverrides, setFileOverrides] = useState<Map<string, DriveAssignment>>(new Map())
21	
22	  const setGroupAssignment = useCallback((groupKey: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => {
23	    setGroupAssignments(prev => new Map(prev).set(groupKey, assignment))
24	  }, [])
25	
26	  const clearGroupAssignment = useCallback((groupKey: string) => {
27	    setGroupAssignments(prev => {
28	      const next = new Map(prev)
29	      next.delete(groupKey)
30	      return next
31	    })
32	  }, [])
33	
34	  const setFileOverride = useCallback((filePath: string, assignment: DriveAssignment) => {
35	    setFileOverrides(prev => new Map(prev).set(filePath, assignment))
36	  }, [])
37	
38	  const clearFileOverride = useCallback((filePath: string) => {
39	    setFileOverrides(prev => {
40	      const next = new Map(prev)
41	      next.delete(filePath)
42	      return next
43	    })
44	  }, [])
45	
46	  return { groupAssignments, fileOverrides, setGroupAssignment, clearGroupAssignment, setFileOverride, clearFileOverride }
47	}
48	
49	// Effective Drive assignment for every file in the tree: its own override,
50	// else the nearest ancestor group's assignment, else null. Mirrors the
51	// inheritance walk GroupNode/FileList do inline during render (same
52	// groupKey scheme: joined by '/', rooted at each top-level subgroup's own
53	// name), but usable outside a render tree — e.g. to check whether every
54	// file is ready to upload, or to build an upload job list.
55	export function resolveEffectiveAssignments(
56	  tree: LocalFileGroup,
57	  { groupAssignments, fileOverrides }: Pick<DriveAssignmentsHandle, 'groupAssignments' | 'fileOverrides'>
58	): Map<string, DriveAssignment | null> {
59	  const result = new Map<string, DriveAssignment | null>()
60	
61	  const walk = (group: LocalFileGroup, groupKey: string | null, inherited: DriveAssignment | null) => {
62	    const effective = (groupKey !== null ? groupAssignments.get(groupKey) : undefined) ?? inherited
63	    for (const file of group.files) {
64	      result.set(file.path, fileOverrides.get(file.path) ?? effective)
65	    }
66	    for (const sub of group.subgroups) {
67	      walk(sub, groupKey !== null ? `${groupKey}/${sub.name}` : sub.name, effective)
68	    }
69	  }
70	  walk(tree, null, null)
71	
72	  return result
73	}

4	import { InclusionHandle } from './useInclusion'

8	export interface UploadFlowHandle {
9	  started: boolean
10	  uploadModalOpen: boolean
11	  readyToUpload: boolean
12	  startUpload: () => void
13	  closeUploadModal: () => void
14	  reset: () => void
15	}
16	
17	// Once Upload All is clicked, the tree locks for the rest of this tree's
18	// session — the upload starts immediately, so there's no "in progress but
19	// not locked yet" window to account for. Retrying failed files happens
20	// inside the upload modal, not from here, so `started` never goes back to
21	// false except via reset (a fresh root pick).
22	export function useUploadFlow(tree: LocalFileGroup | null, inclusion: InclusionHandle, assignments: DriveAssignmentsHandle): UploadFlowHandle {
23	  const [uploadModalOpen, setUploadModalOpen] = useState(false)
24	  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false)
25	
26	  const allFiles = tree ? flattenFiles(tree) : []
27	  const selectedFiles = allFiles.filter(f => inclusion.isFileSelected(f.path))
28	  const effectiveAssignments = tree ? resolveEffectiveAssignments(tree, assignments) : null
29	  const readyToUpload = selectedFiles.length > 0 && selectedFiles.every(f => effectiveAssignments!.get(f.path) != null)
30	
31	  const startUpload = () => {
32	    if (!tree || !effectiveAssignments) return
33	    uploadQueue.start(selectedFiles.map(f => {
34	      const assignment = effectiveAssignments.get(f.path)
35	      // Upload All is disabled until readyToUpload is true, so every file
36	      // should resolve here — this is a defensive check against that
37	      // guard and this walk drifting out of sync, not an expected path.
38	      if (!assignment) throw new Error(`No Drive folder assigned for "${f.path}"`)
39	      return { path: f.path, folderId: assignment.driveFolderId, name: f.name }
40	    }))
41	    setStarted(true)
42	    setUploadModalOpen(true)
43	  }
44	
45	  const closeUploadModal = () => setUploadModalOpen(false)
46	
47	  // A new root discards the old tree's upload-queue state along with it —
48	  // picking a new root is the only way out of the read-only lock.
49	  const reset = () => {
50	    uploadQueue.reset()
51	    setStarted(false)
52	  }
53	
54	  return { started, uploadModalOpen, readyToUpload, startUpload, closeUploadModal, reset }
55	}

1	import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'
2	import { flattenFiles } from './useFileTree'
3	import { LocalFileGroup } from '../types'
4	
5	export type GroupSelectionState = 'checked' | 'unchecked' | 'indeterminate'
6	
7	export interface InclusionHandle {
8	  isFileSelected: (path: string) => boolean
9	  getGroupState: (group: LocalFileGroup) => GroupSelectionState
10	  toggleFile: (path: string) => void
11	  toggleGroup: (group: LocalFileGroup) => void
12	  selectAll: () => void
13	  selectNone: () => void
14	}
15	
16	// Tracks which files are excluded from the upload, keyed by path. A
17	// subfolder's checkbox state is derived from its descendant files rather
18	// than stored separately, so the "fully selected/unselected collapses all
19	// the way up the tree" behavior falls out of the derivation for free
20	// instead of needing explicit upward-propagation bookkeeping.
21	export function useInclusion(tree: LocalFileGroup | null): InclusionHandle {
22	  const [deselected, setDeselected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
23	
24	  // Resets to fully-selected on every fresh scan — deliberately not
25	  // persisted, unlike Drive folder mappings.
26	  useEffect(() => {
27	    setDeselected(new Set())
28	  }, [tree])
29	
30	  const isFileSelected = useCallback((path: string) => !deselected.has(path), [deselected])
31	
32	  const getGroupState = useCallback((group: LocalFileGroup): GroupSelectionState => {
33	    const files = flattenFiles(group)
34	    if (files.length === 0) return 'checked'
35	    const selectedCount = files.filter(f => !deselected.has(f.path)).length
36	    if (selectedCount === 0) return 'unchecked'
37	    if (selectedCount === files.length) return 'checked'
38	    return 'indeterminate'
39	  }, [deselected])
40	
41	  const toggleFile = useCallback((path: string) => {
42	    setDeselected(prev => {
43	      const next = new Set(prev)
44	      if (next.has(path)) next.delete(path); else next.add(path)
45	      return next
46	    })
47	  }, [])
48	
49	  // Indeterminate or fully-unselected groups select all descendants; a
50	  // fully-selected group deselects all descendants. Decided from the
51	  // group's own current state rather than the checkbox's native toggle, so
52	  // clicking an indeterminate checkbox always selects, never clears.
53	  const toggleGroup = useCallback((group: LocalFileGroup) => {
54	    const files = flattenFiles(group)
55	    setDeselected(prev => {
56	      const allSelected = files.every(f => !prev.has(f.path))
57	      const next = new Set(prev)
58	      for (const f of files) {
59	        if (allSelected) next.add(f.path); else next.delete(f.path)
60	      }
61	      return next
62	    })
63	  }, [])
64	
65	  const selectAll = useCallback(() => setDeselected(new Set()), [])
66	
67	  const selectNone = useCallback(() => {
68	    setDeselected(new Set(tree ? flattenFiles(tree).map(f => f.path) : []))
69	  }, [tree])
70	
71	  return { isFileSelected, getGroupState, toggleFile, toggleGroup, selectAll, selectNone }
72	}

4	function itemKey(item: SelectionItem): string {

6	}

8	export interface SelectionHandle {
9	  size: number
10	  items: SelectionItem[]
11	  isSelected: (item: SelectionItem) => boolean
12	  // Plain click: replaces the selection with just this item.
13	  replace: (item: SelectionItem) => void
14	  // Cmd/Ctrl-click: adds or removes this item from the existing selection.
15	  toggle: (item: SelectionItem) => void
16	}
17	
18	// The shared multi-selection of files and subfolders driving both row
19	// highlighting and (Step 3e) batch Drive folder assignment — a single
20	// selection concept rather than a separate preview-only highlight.
21	export function useSelection(tree: LocalFileGroup | null): SelectionHandle {
22	  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Map<string, SelectionItem>>(new Map())
23	
24	  // Resets on every fresh scan, like inclusion — a new root's rows aren't
25	  // the ones that were selected under the old one.
26	  useEffect(() => {
27	    setSelected(new Map())
28	  }, [tree])
29	
30	  const isSelected = useCallback((item: SelectionItem) => selected.has(itemKey(item)), [selected])
31	
32	  const replace = useCallback((item: SelectionItem) => {
33	    setSelected(new Map([[itemKey(item), item]]))
34	  }, [])
35	
36	  const toggle = useCallback((item: SelectionItem) => {
37	    setSelected(prev => {
38	      const key = itemKey(item)
39	      const next = new Map(prev)
40	      if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key); else next.set(key, item)
41	      return next
42	    })
43	  }, [])
44	
45	  return { size: selected.size, items: Array.from(selected.values()), isSelected, replace, toggle }
46	}
